name: yank-evil-ghostel
comment: evil-ghostel: copying terminal output to the prompt, and operators applied on an output row. Yanks come from scrollback rows (yiw yw v e y yy V y V j y, a named register, a count) and are pasted at the live prompt with p / P; the shell is the oracle (the pasted text must run as the command). Linewise yanks paste the row text plus its newline into the input: nothing may run before RET. Operators (x X dd D dw v e d r cw C) applied on an output row, with a command typed at the prompt, must leave the typed command and the row unchanged. Known failures are marked expect=fail: visual p does not replace the selection, and p/P with point on an output row send Up arrows to the shell (history recall replaces the typed line). Every group starts in insert state at an empty prompt and uses its own marker text. Driven on zsh.

steps.eval: (ghostel)

steps.comment: helpers: row/line counters over the whole buffer and the typed text on the cursor row

steps.eval: (progn (defun yank--n (re) (with-current-buffer "*ghostel*" (save-excursion (goto-char (point-min)) (let ((n 0)) (while (re-search-forward re nil t) (setq n (1+ n))) n)))) (defun yank--input () (with-current-buffer "*ghostel*" (save-excursion (goto-char ghostel--cursor-char-pos) (string-trim-right (buffer-substring-no-properties (ghostel-input-start-point) (line-end-position)))))))

steps.comment: short prompt
yiw on an output row, G, p at the end of 'echo ': the word lands after the cursor

steps.keys: <escape> k 0 w y i w G p

steps.eval: (unless (equal "echo y01src" (yank--input)) (error "YIW-P input=%S" (yank--input)))

steps.comment: yw: ghostel's copy cleaning strips trailing whitespace, so the yanked word carries no trailing space

steps.keys: <escape> k 0 w y w G p

steps.eval: (unless (equal "echo y02src" (yank--input)) (error "YW-P input=%S" (yank--input)))

steps.comment: P with point on the first of 'ZZ' (G, h) pastes before it

steps.keys: <escape> k 0 w y i w G h P

steps.eval: (unless (equal "echo y03srcZZ" (yank--input)) (error "P input=%S" (yank--input)))

steps.comment: p with point on the first of 'ZZ' (G, h) pastes between the two characters (right arrow, then paste)

steps.keys: <escape> k 0 w y i w G h p

steps.eval: (unless (equal "echo Zy04srcZ" (yank--input)) (error "P-MID input=%S" (yank--input)))

steps.comment: characterwise visual yank v e y from output, p at the prompt

steps.keys: <escape> k 0 w v e y G p

steps.eval: (unless (equal "echo y05src" (yank--input)) (error "V-Y input=%S" (yank--input)))

steps.comment: "ayiw, then a later yank into the unnamed register: "ap should paste register a; the paste commands drop the register argument and paste the latest yank

steps.keys: <escape> k 0 w " a y i w w y i w G " a p

steps.eval: (unless (equal "echo y06src" (yank--input)) (error "REGISTER input=%S" (yank--input)))
steps.reason: evil-ghostel-paste-after/-before use (interactive "P") without <x>, so the "a prefix never reaches do-paste; the unnamed register is pasted (echo zzz)

steps.comment: 2p pastes the register twice

steps.keys: <escape> k 0 w y i w G 2 p

steps.eval: (unless (equal "echo y07srcy07src" (yank--input)) (error "COUNT input=%S" (yank--input)))

steps.comment: yy on an output row: the pasted text is the row plus its newline, inserted into the input; nothing runs before RET, then the multi-line input runs once

steps.eval: (unless (= 0 (yank--n "^y08ok$")) (error "YY EARLY-RUN count=%d (want 0)" (yank--n "^y08ok$")))
(unless (= 1 (yank--n "^> echo y08ok$")) (error "YY NOT-PASTED count=%d (want 1)" (yank--n "^> echo y08ok$")))
(unless (= 1 (yank--n "^y08ok$")) (error "YY RUN-ONCE count=%d (want 1)" (yank--n "^y08ok$")))

steps.comment: V y on an output row pastes the same way

steps.eval: (unless (= 0 (yank--n "^y09ok$")) (error "V-Y EARLY-RUN count=%d (want 0)" (yank--n "^y09ok$")))
(unless (= 1 (yank--n "^> echo y09ok$")) (error "V-Y NOT-PASTED count=%d (want 1)" (yank--n "^> echo y09ok$")))
(unless (= 1 (yank--n "^y09ok$")) (error "V-Y RUN-ONCE count=%d (want 1)" (yank--n "^y09ok$")))

steps.comment: V j y over two output rows pastes both rows as a two-line input; neither runs before RET, both run once after

steps.keys: <escape> k k 0 V j y G p

steps.eval: (unless (= 0 (yank--n "^y10a$")) (error "V-J-Y EARLY-RUN count=%d (want 0)" (yank--n "^y10a$")))
(unless (= 0 (yank--n "^y10b$")) (error "V-J-Y EARLY-RUN count=%d (want 0)" (yank--n "^y10b$")))
(unless (= 1 (yank--n "^> echo y10a$")) (error "V-J-Y NOT-PASTED count=%d (want 1)" (yank--n "^> echo y10a$")))
(unless (= 1 (yank--n "^y10a$")) (error "V-J-Y RUN-ONCE count=%d (want 1)" (yank--n "^y10a$")))
(unless (= 1 (yank--n "^y10b$")) (error "V-J-Y RUN-ONCE count=%d (want 1)" (yank--n "^y10b$")))

steps.comment: viw p over typed input should replace the selection (Evil's visual p); evil-ghostel remaps it to the plain paste, which ignores the region and leaves visual state active

steps.keys: <escape> k 0 w y i w G ^ w v i w p

steps.eval: (unless (eq evil-state 'normal) (error "VISUAL-P state=%s" evil-state))
steps.reason: visual p is remapped to evil-ghostel-paste-after, which never leaves visual state
the selection is not replaced: the register text is appended after the typed word (echo BADy11src)

steps.comment: x on an output row: no-op for the input and the row

steps.eval: (unless (= 1 (yank--n "^aaa y12 zzz$")) (error "OUT-X ROW-CHANGED count=%d (want 1)" (yank--n "^aaa y12 zzz$")))
(unless (equal "echo y12cmd" (yank--input)) (error "OUT-X input=%S" (yank--input)))
(unless (= 1 (yank--n "^aaa y12 zzz$")) (error "OUT-X ROW-CHANGED-AFTER-RUN count=%d (want 1)" (yank--n "^aaa y12 zzz$")))

steps.comment: p with point on an output row must paste at the prompt without touching the rest of the typed line

steps.keys: <escape> k 0 w y i w p

steps.eval: (let ((s (string-replace "y21src" "" (yank--input)))) (unless (equal s "echo y21cmd") (error "P-OUTPUT-ROW typed line is now %S (input %S)" s (yank--input))))
steps.reason: point on an output row: goto-input-position sends Up arrows to the shell, which recalls history and replaces the typed command

steps.comment: P with point on an output row: same expectation as p

steps.keys: <escape> k 0 w y i w P

steps.eval: (let ((s (string-replace "y22src" "" (yank--input)))) (unless (equal s "echo y22cmd") (error "P-OUTPUT-ROW typed line is now %S (input %S)" s (yank--input))))
steps.reason: point on an output row: goto-input-position sends Up arrows to the shell, which recalls history and replaces the typed command
